title: [SAMPLE DATA] Attendance Policy
text: This is placeholder sample content, not real IIT Bhubaneswar data. It exists only so you can run chunk_documents.py and embed_and_store.py once before you have real scraped data. Replace this file by running scripts/extract_pages.py against real public pages listed in data/raw/seed_urls.txt. Example policy text: students must maintain a minimum of 75 percent attendance in each registered course per semester to be eligible to sit for the end-semester examination. Students between 65 and 75 percent attendance may be granted a condonation on medical or other grounds, subject to approval by the department's academic committee. Students below 65 percent attendance are normally debarred from the end-semester examination for that course.
